paragraph: The Granville composite registers a mildly constructive 56/100 this morning, establishing a stable technical baseline with no breadth divergence warnings currently active across the tape. Underlying indicators reflect a largely balanced posture led by favorable volatility (-0.27% on the VIX) and subtle risk-seeking flows in high-beta assets (SPHB/SPLV +0.44%), despite minor friction from bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY -0.12%) and steady transports (IYT/SPY +0.30%). Macro conditions broadly validate this steady tape, characterized by a complacent VIX print of 14.59, a steep volatility term structure in contango (6.5 front-month to 18.6 back-month), tight high-yield credit spreads at 2.71%, and anchored 10-year real yields at 2.42%. Additional structural tailwinds from a softening dollar ($28.09) and firm small-cap relative strength (0.3914) provide sufficient liquidity insulation to keep distribution risks low. Directional lean for the session is a modest, low-volatility upward drift, favoring selective long risk exposure while respecting the lack of decisive upside breadth thrusts.
